Where are your accreditations hiding?

On a lot of installer sites they sit in the footer: four tiny grey logos next to the privacy link.

That's the one place a buyer doesn't look while they're deciding whether to ask you for a quote.

Move them to where the decision happens:
1. Right next to your quote button.
2. In plain words, not just a logo. "MCS certified installer" (or NABCEP, CEC, whatever you hold) reads faster than a badge nobody recognises.
3. If your scheme has a public register, link to your entry so people can check it in one tap.

Same certificate, same page. It just has to sit where people can see it.
